segs.pali: (23) 3. Duccaritavaggo
segs.zh: 3. 恶行品

segs.pali: 1. Duccaritasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 1. [[duccaritasutta|恶行经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Cattārimāni , bhikkhave, vacīduccaritāni. Katamāni cattāri? Musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo – imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri vacīduccaritāni. Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, vacīsucaritāni. Katamāni cattāri? Saccavācā, apisuṇā vācā, saṇhā vācā, mantavācā – imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri vacīsucaritānī’’ti. Paṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，有四种语恶行。哪四种？妄语、两舌、粗恶语、杂秽语。诸比丘，这便是四种语恶行。诸比丘，有四种语善行。哪四种？真实语、不两舌、柔和语、有益语。诸比丘，这便是四种语善行。第一。”

segs.pali: 2. Diṭṭhisuttaṃ
segs.zh: 2. [[diṭṭhisutta|见经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ; bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati. Katamehi catūhi? Kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, micchādiṭṭhiyā – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足四法的愚者、无能者、非善人，持守着已被毁坏、已被损害的自身，他有过失，受智者呵责，并造作众多非福。哪四种？身恶行、语恶行、意恶行、邪见。诸比丘，具足这四法的愚者、无能者、非善人，持守着已被毁坏、已被损害的自身，他有过失，受智者呵责，并造作众多非福。

segs.pali: ‘‘Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati. Katamehi catūhi? Kāyasucaritena, vacīsucaritena, manosucaritena, sammādiṭṭhiyā – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ; bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatī’’ti. Dutiyaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足四法的有智之人、贤能善士，护持自身无有损坏、无有伤害，他清净无罪，不为智者所呵责，并能广积福德。哪四种？身善行、语善行、意善行、正见。诸比丘，具足这四法的有智之人、贤能善士，护持自身无有损坏、无有伤害，他清净无罪，不为智者所呵责，并能广积福德。”第二。

segs.pali: 3. Akataññutāsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 3. [[akataññutāsutta|不知恩经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Catūhi , bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati. Katamehi catūhi? Kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, akataññutā akataveditā – imehi…pe… paṇḍito… kāyasucaritena, vacīsucaritena, manosucaritena kataññutākataveditā…pe…. Tatiyaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足四法的愚者、无能者、非善人，令自身陷于毁伤败坏，他有罪，为智者所呵责，并造作众多非福。哪四种？身恶行、语恶行、意恶行、忘恩不知报。以这四法，愚者如是。而智者则具足身善行、语善行、意善行、知恩知报。第三。

segs.pali: 4. Pāṇātipātīsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 4. [[pāṇātipātīsutta|杀生者经]]

segs.pali: … Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti…pe… pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti…pe…. Catutthaṃ.
segs.zh: 他杀生、不与取、行欲邪行、说妄语……他远离杀生、远离不与取、远离欲邪行、远离妄语……第四。

segs.pali: 5. Paṭhamamaggasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 5. [[paṭhamamaggasutta|第一道经]]

segs.pali: … Micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, micchāsaṅkappo hoti, micchāvāco hoti, micchākammanto hoti…pe… sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, sammāsaṅkappo hoti, sammāvāco hoti, sammākammanto hoti…pe…. Pañcamaṃ.
segs.zh: ……邪见者、邪思惟者、邪语者、邪业者……正见者、正思惟者、正语者、正业者……。第五。

segs.pali: 6. Dutiyamaggasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 6. [[dutiyamaggasutta|第二道经]]

segs.pali: … Micchāājīvo hoti, micchāvāyāmo hoti, micchāsati hoti, micchāsamādhi hoti…pe… sammāājīvo hoti, sammāvāyāmo hoti, sammāsati hoti, sammāsamādhi hoti…pe…. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
segs.zh: ……邪命者、邪精进者、邪念者、邪定者……正命者、正精进者、正念者、正定者……。第六。

segs.pali: 7. Paṭhamavohārapathasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 7. [[paṭhamavohārapathasutta|第一言路经]]

segs.pali: … Adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti…pe… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādī hoti…pe…. Sattamaṃ.
segs.zh: 于未见而言已见，于未闻而言已闻，于未觉而言已觉，于未识而言已识……于未见而言未见，于未闻而言未闻，于未觉而言未觉，于未识而言未识……。第七。

segs.pali: 8. Dutiyavohārapathasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 8. [[dutiyavohārapathasutta|第二言路经]]

segs.pali: … Diṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, sute asutavādī hoti, mute amutavādī hoti, viññāte aviññātavādī hoti…pe… diṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, sute sutavādī hoti, mute mutavādī hoti, viññāte viññātavādī hoti…pe…. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: ……于所见却说未所见，于所闻却说未所闻，于所觉却说未所觉，于所识却说未所识……于所见则如实见，于所闻则如实闻，于所觉则如实觉，于所识则如实识……第八。

segs.pali: 9. Ahirikasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 9. [[ahirikasutta|无惭经]]

segs.pali: … Assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti…pe… saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti…pe…. Navamaṃ.
segs.zh: ……无信者、破戒者、无惭者、无愧者……有信者、持戒者、具惭者、具愧者……第九。

segs.pali: 10. Duppaññasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 10. [[duppaññasutta|劣慧经]]

segs.pali: … Assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti…pe… saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
segs.zh: 无信者、破戒者、懈怠者、劣慧者……有信者、持戒者、精勤者、有慧者——诸比丘，具足此四法，便是贤明、精通的善士，能令自己无有损伤、无有毁害，无罪无过，不被智者所指责，并能积聚广大的福德。”第十。

segs.pali: 11. Kavisuttaṃ
segs.zh: 11. [[kavisutta|诗人经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Cattārome , bhikkhave, kavī. Katame cattāro? Cintākavi, sutakavi, atthakavi, paṭibhānakavi – ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro kavī’’ti. Ekādasamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，有四种诗人。何等为四？思惟诗人、多闻诗人、义理诗人、辩才诗人。诸比丘，是为四种诗人。”第十一。

segs.pali: Duccaritavaggo tatiyo.
segs.zh: 恶行品第三

segs.pali: Tassuddānaṃ –
segs.zh: 其摄颂：

segs.pali: Duccaritaṃ diṭṭhi akataññū ca, pāṇātipātāpi dve maggā;
segs.zh: 恶行、邪见、忘恩，及杀生，此为二道；

segs.pali: Dve vohārapathā vuttā, ahirikaṃ duppaññakavinā cāti.
segs.zh: 已说二种言说之道，无惭者、劣慧者与诗家。
